adaptiveLearning.rule: Positive learning influence grows automatically with reconciled sample depth and per-dimension evidence. profitabilityAdmissionPolicy.rule: Every stock setup remains shadow-only until at least 100 independent outcomes across 20 trading days pass positive expectancy, profit-factor, regime and safety gates.
